meaning: A phone setting that silences calls and alerts for a while. You choose who can still get through.
clues: It helps you get some peace and quiet.
It silences calls and alerts, and you can set it to turn on every night.
You can let certain people through, such as family, or someone who calls twice in a row.
Many people use it at bedtime so late calls do not wake them up.
It has three words. The first starts with D.
assumes: Call blocking stops calls from numbers you pick
A ringtone is the sound your phone plays when it rings
A speakerphone plays a call out loud

decoys.meaning: A feature that stops calls from numbers you pick.
The sound a phone plays when someone calls.
A setting that plays a call out loud so you can talk without holding the phone.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: We hung a paper sign on the door: "Do Not Disturb." It worked on everyone except my cat.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: set a bedtime schedule, then add your family as exceptions. Urgent calls still ring, and the rest wait until morning.
